description.narrative:
Overall objective: Thai Nguyen tea value chain becomes more sustainable, climate resilience, and gender responsive contributing to local social and economic development.
To improve the sustainability, climate resilience, gender responsiveness of the tea value chain in Thai Nguyen and its contribution to the local social-economic development, it is necessary to support the adoption of climateresilient and sustainable practices and market-required quality standards, digitalization and advanced technologies in production and processing, development of sale and marketing profiles and channels that effectively improve the reach-out to final consumers, enhance producer organization and value chain peer collaboration particularly among poor, ethnic and women producers and their collaboration with other actors. By that, the overall tea value chain development will become more equal and gender responsive. (i) For teacooperatives to adopt sustainable practices and quality standards, digitalization and advanced technologies, the project will provide them with technical support and implementation of VietGAP (Good Agricultural Practices) and organic standards in tea production, optimization and sustainable use of fertilizer, pesticides and water, adoption of digitalization in tea production management, traceability, and area coding, shift to biomass gasification for tea drying instead burning wood in open air. Specifically for sustainable production practices, the project targets to improve VietGAP implementation among poor, ethnic and women tea cooperatives, whereasenhance organic tea production among few advance cooperatives as role model. Moreover, the project will support targeted tea producer cooperatives to develop appropriate intervention to be resilient with climate change impact. (ii) To support tea cooperatives to increase their sales, the project will help them achieve more balanced sales and marketing channels. Beside conventional channel of peer introduction and recommendation among consumers, the tea cooperative will be supported to diversify sale and marketing channel through development of product and cooperative profiling, digital marketing contents, marketing and livestreaming channels, e-commerce, and participate local and national trade fairs and promotional events to improve their profiles and outreach to more consumers. In addition, the project will support tea cooperatives in labeling their products as “low-carbon tea”. (iii) To support tea cooperatives to implement the above-mentionedactions, particularly adoption of biomass gasification technology, digital tools for tea production management, traceability, and livestreaming sale and marketing which require financial investment, the project will support to enable their effective access to available resources and assistance.
